text: In Money Heist, what is the Professor's real identity name?
funFact: Sergio Marquina spent years orchestrating the Royal Mint heist in honor of his father.

text: Which iconic building does the gang target in the first heist?
funFact: Instead of stealing stored cash, they printed 984 million euros of unrecorded banknotes.

text: Whose artist face is depicted on the masks worn by the robbers?
funFact: Salvador Dalí's surrealist mask became a global symbol of resistance and defiance.

text: Which Italian resistance song is the heist crew's official anthem?
funFact: Bella Ciao was taught to the Professor by his grandfather who fought the fascists in Italy.

text: What relation is Berlin (Andrés) to the Professor (Sergio)?
funFact: Berlin and Sergio shared the same father, Jesús Marquina, who died during a heist.

text: What is Tokyo's real name in the series?
funFact: Silene Oliveira served as the main voiceover narrator throughout all seasons of the heist.

text: Which city codename was selected by the young hacking prodigy of the crew?
funFact: Rio (Aníbal Cortés) built the encrypted satellite link communicating with the Professor.

text: What target does the crew breach in parts 3 to 5 of the series?
funFact: They melted 90 tons of the Bank of Spain's gold reserve into micro-pellets to pump it out.

text: Which inspector led the police negotiations and later joined the crew as 'Lisbon'?
funFact: Raquel Murillo tracked the Professor using postcards sent from Palawan, Philippines.

text: What is Nairobi's famous battle cry when taking charge of the printing room?
funFact: 'Let the matriarchy begin!' became one of the most iconic lines in TV history.

text: What precious material does the crew melt down and steal from the Bank of Spain?
funFact: The crew replaced the stolen 90 tons of gold reserve with brass bars coated in gold paint!
